issue_request: FHIR-20499 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested moving Request.intent instance-order out from under filler-order to order because instance orders can be created by either placing or filling systems, and it requested clarified definitions for original-order, filler-order, and instance-order.
initial_application: Git 849d838231 applied the issue to source/request/codesystem-request-intent.xml by moving instance-order under order and adding the clarified definitions. The active request spreadsheet was not updated, leaving the worksheet hierarchy and definitions stale.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists request as an active logical pattern, and build.fhir.org/codesystem-request-intent.json showed current generated output still following the stale worksheet by including worksheet-only solicit-offer/offer-response and nesting instance-order under filler-order. FHIR-I Workflow minutes from 2019-03-04 corroborate the lab/EHR scenario behind the tracker. FHIR-13999 is the same hierarchy family for MedicationRequest and is already represented on the combined branch; FHIR-56142 is later escape-valve work and not a hierarchy reversal.
reconciliation: Updated source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml so original-order, filler-order, and instance-order definitions align with the already-correct RequestIntent CodeSystem XML, and changed the instance-order parent from filler-order to order in the request-intent worksheet.
